basis: QA-165 (#1318 review M1, 8 Nov 2026): a form field IRCC's field list marks required (the inventory's `required`) whose own form script makes it required only for some answers is mandatory only then, so readiness never waits on it otherwise (P-71). Read from the form's own script (P-170), never guessed: IMM 5257 (09-2023), page 2, Passport section, Question 2 ("The country or territory that issued your passport"), the script on CountryofIssue marked "//April032018 - Added for CR 330212": `if(this.rawValue == "203") { … color.markRequired(TaiwanPIN.No) … color.markUnRequired(IsraelPassportIndicator.No) … }`, the "206" branch the other way round, and `else{ … color.markUnRequired(TaiwanPIN.No) … color.markUnRequired(IsraelPassportIndicator.No) … }`. Source: prototype/expected/source-text/imm5257e.xfa-template.txt, the visible text and scripts of official-sources/ircc/forms/imm5257e.pdf (SHA-256 0dc03b24e7914a178ad29e2cfae811045835a1d36d7a3c35f040251d0aca562e, downloaded 19 Oct 2026), read 8 Nov 2026. The codes are the form's own (its country list's saved values); the condition compares the code a copy writes into that box. Sample, Unconfirmed: expert.

fields.words: the passport's country or territory of issue is the one the form's code 203 names (Taiwan PIN, Passport Question 5)
the passport's country or territory of issue is the one the form's code 206 names (National Israeli passport, Passport Question 6)
